# acme-design-system

> Accessible React components on design tokens (Radix UI and Tailwind CSS v4), published as a
> shadcn registry. Each link below is a registry item: JSON holding the component's full source
> and its dependencies. Install one with `npx shadcn@latest add https://joela510.github.io/agent-ready-template/r/<name>.json`.

Storybook, at this site's root, shows every component in every state, in light and dark.

## Components

## Utilities

- [useIsMobile hook](https://joela510.github.io/agent-ready-template/r/use-mobile.json): matchMedia-backed hook that reports whether the viewport is below the mobile breakpoint.
- [cn() utility](https://joela510.github.io/agent-ready-template/r/utils.json): clsx + tailwind-merge class-name helper used by every component.
